question: For each instance VM state on host 'blaze8-12', list the VM state, the total memory (in MB) across non-deleted instances (only keeping VM states whose total memory is greater than the overall average memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for non-deleted instances on that host), and the geometric mean instance memory (in MB) across instances with a system metadata entry where key = 'image_image_type' and memory_mb > 0. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT vm_state, memory_mb, uuid
  FROM instances
  WHERE host = 'blaze8-12' AND deleted = 0
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_mem, STDDEV(memory_mb) AS sd_mem
  FROM base
),
totals AS (
  SELECT vm_state, SUM(memory_mb) AS total_memory
  FROM base
  GROUP BY vm_state
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT t.vm_state, t.total_memory
  FROM totals t
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE t.total_memory > o.avg_mem + o.sd_mem
),
geo AS (
  SELECT b.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(b.memory_mb))) AS geo_mean_memory
  FROM base b
  JOIN instance_system_metadata sm ON sm.instance_uuid = b.uuid
  WHERE sm.key = 'image_image_type' AND b.memory_mb > 0
  GROUP BY b.vm_state
)
SELECT q.vm_state, q.total_memory, g.geo_mean_memory
FROM qualifying q
LEFT JOIN geo g ON g.vm_state = q.vm_state

  FROM instances
  WHERE host = 'blaze8-12' AND deleted = 0
